description: Describes one file or folder in Google Drive without reading its content. Takes the file ID. Returns its name, MIME type, size in bytes when Drive reports one (folders have none), the IDs of the folders it is in, its owners' names and addresses, when it was created and last modified, its link, whether it is in Trash, whether it is shared, and the shared drive it belongs to when it is in one. A file the account cannot see answers as not found.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

file_id.description: The Google Drive file or folder ID to describe

name: gws-mcp__drive_get_file
